# Hypermandala

> Interactive 4D mandala, yantra and geometry explorer. Geometric 2D plans unfold into intrinsic 3D forms and genuine 4D projections with rotation in all six coordinate planes.

Hypermandala is a free, dependency-free Canvas visualization that runs in the browser. It is an experimental project by Mario Marcolongo. It does not claim to be the first 3D Sri Yantra visualization; earlier interactive and downloadable 3D Sri Yantra work exists.

## Project

- [Live explorer](https://hypermandala.mariomarcolongo.com/): the interactive application
- [Source code](https://github.com/mariomarcolongo/hypermandala): repository, documentation and license
- [Release 0.1.0 on Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23391082): archived version to cite
- [Project page](https://mariomarcolongo.com/work/hypermandala): the author's summary of the project
